text:
sarah.k: Heads up — we're getting a noisy spike of blackbox probe failures in eastus2 for the streaming inference endpoints (both websocket and SSE). Alerts started ~08:12 UTC and are flipping a lot (timeouts / 502s). Anyone else seeing this? cc @mike_g @cheng

obs-bot: Prometheus alert fired: BLACKBOX_HTTP_STATUS_DOWN (3 targets) · region=eastus2 · group=streaming · https://prometheus.internal/redwood/alerts/2345

mike_g: Yep, saw same. I correlated with the GPU autoscaler events — a couple of nodes scaled down and then back up around 08:10-08:14. Some cold starts appear to take >10s to accept websocket handshake, so blackbox_exporter (default timeout 10s) is timing out.

cheng: Streaming endpoints are fragile on cold start because we initialize KV cache and a couple of kernels on the first request. For SSE, backend relies on chunked keepalive but nginx proxy_read_timeout was 15s; if our keepalive bursts miss, the reverse-proxy closes first.

lina_ops: Two quick thoughts: (1) Don't use the same blackbox config for regular HTTP probes and streaming probes — streaming needs longer timeouts and different detection. (2) Tune the alert so we don't alert on one-off cold starts. Suggest requiring 3 consecutive failures within 5m before firing.

mike_g: Agreed. I'm going to spin up a dedicated streaming probe job that uses websocat to do a real websocket handshake + one ping, and another probe for SSE that waits for the first chunk. That avoids false positives from plain http_get. Example idea for a k8s Job using websocat:

```
# pseudo-k8s CronJob that runs a check and exits non-zero on failure
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: streaming-probe-eastus2
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: checker
        image: "vi/websocat:latest"
        args: ["-1", "ws://inference-eastus2.internal/v1/stream", "--ping=1000"]
      restartPolicy: Never
```

(We run this from a small pool of probe pods distributed across AZs in the region.)

cheng: For blackbox_exporter we can also add a module that increases timeout and does a TCP connect + HTTP upgrade headers for ws:

```
modules:
  streaming_ws:
    prober: http
    timeout: 30s
    http:
      valid_http_versions: ["HTTP/1.1"]
      method: GET
      headers:
        Connection: ["Upgrade"]
        Upgrade: ["websocket"]
      tls_config:
        insecure_skip_verify: true
```

Note: blackbox's http probe won't complete a real websocket exchange, so it's a heuristic. That's why mike's synthetic client + job is better for true health.

lina_ops: Also update the Prom alert rule to require 3 failures: sample rule draft: 

```
- alert: StreamingEndpointDown
  expr: increase(probe_success{job="blackbox",module="streaming_ws",region="eastus2"}[5m]) == 0
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "Streaming probes failing in eastus2"
    description: "{{ $labels.instance }} has 0 successful streaming probes in the last 5m"
```

(This uses increase() so transient flaps won't immediately page.)

sarah.k: Action items: (1) mike_g — deploy the websocket/sse probe job and add the blackbox module PR (2) cheng — add the Prom alert rule and update the SLO dashboard to include a streaming_connection_duration panel + failure-rate by cold-start vs steady state (3) lina_ops — adjust alert thresholds in PagerDuty to require 3 consecutive failures. Please @-mention me on PRs.

mike_g: On it. I'll open the blackbox_exporter config PR and a k8s Job manifest. ETA ~2h. Will add job affinity so probes are spread across AZs. :thumbsup:

cheng: I'll update the alerting rules and add a Grafana panel for connection_duration histogram (we already histogram the handshake latency in the service metrics). Also will add a dashboard row flagged as "streaming health" so PMs can see it.

lina_ops: I'll coordinate with cost to ensure additional probe pods don't blow budgets — we can limit to 3 small probes per region and set resource limits. Also will pin probe nodes to non-GPU infra to avoid accidental GPU billing.

sarah.k: Thanks — let's keep this thread for updates. If the noise persists after fixes, we'll consider temporary lowering autoscaler aggression on the streaming pool.

mike_g: deployed probe job to staging, running a few minutes now. I'll post logs in this thread shortly.

obs-bot: Alert resolved: BLACKBOX_HTTP_STATUS_DOWN (eastus2) — 09:05 UTC

sarah.k: Nice. Follow-ups in next oncall handover.
